## Swift Package Manager

Add the repository URL in Xcode or your `Package.swift` and select the **BaglamaSoundML** product. See the README for a command-line audio demo and the Swift integration guide.

Pass a compatible portable JSON model to the package. Download a model from the release assets when available, or export one from your local training workflow. Recordings, feedback databases, and generated audio remain local.

Synthesis is experimental. Treat version tags as immutable.
